description:
The process starts when an employee or department submits a request for an IT solution, such as new software or hardware.
IT assesses the request, checking for compatibility with existing systems and evaluating cost and resource needs.
If approved, IT procures the necessary tools or licenses, installs the solution, and tests it in a controlled environment.
After successful testing, the new solution is rolled out to the requesting department.
Training may be provided, and IT support remains available for troubleshooting.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_ITRequest" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/it-solution-request">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_ITSolutionRequest" name="IT solution request handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_ITRequest">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Requester" name="Requesting employee or department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_SolutionNeed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_IT" name="IT">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Assess_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckCompat</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EvalCost</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EvalResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Assess_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Approval_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Rejected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Procure</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Install</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Test</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RollOut</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Training_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Training</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Training_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Support</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Supported</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_SolutionNeed" name="IT solution need arises">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Submit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitRequest" name="Submit IT solution request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Submit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToAssess</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Assess_Split" name="Start assessment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToAssess</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckCompat</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EvalCost</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EvalResources</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckCompat" name="Check compatibility with existing systems">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckCompat</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CompatDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvalCost" name="Evaluate cost">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EvalCost</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CostDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvalResources" name="Evaluate resource needs">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EvalResources</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ResourcesDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Assess_Join" name="Assessment complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CompatDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CostDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ResourcesDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Assessed</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Approval_Split" name="Request approved?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Assessed</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Rejected</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Rejected" name="Request not approved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Rejected</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Procure" name="Procure tools or licenses">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToInstall</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Install" name="Install solution">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToInstall</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToTest</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Test" name="Test solution in controlled environment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToTest</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToRollOut</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_RollOut" name="Roll out solution to requesting department">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToRollOut</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToTrainingSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Training_Split" name="Training provided?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToTrainingSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrainingYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrainingNo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Training" name="Provide training">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TrainingYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrainingDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Training_Join" name="Training handled">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TrainingDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TrainingNo</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToSupport</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Support" name="Provide IT support for troubleshooting">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToSupport</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Supported" name="Solution supported">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Submit" sourceRef="Start_SolutionNeed" targetRef="Task_SubmitRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToAssess" sourceRef="Task_SubmitRequest" targetRef="Gateway_Assess_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckCompat" sourceRef="Gateway_Assess_Split" targetRef="Task_CheckCompat"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EvalCost" sourceRef="Gateway_Assess_Split" targetRef="Task_EvalCost"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EvalResources" sourceRef="Gateway_Assess_Split" targetRef="Task_EvalResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompatDone" sourceRef="Task_CheckCompat" targetRef="Gateway_Assess_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CostDone" sourceRef="Task_EvalCost" targetRef="Gateway_Assess_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ResourcesDone" sourceRef="Task_EvalResources" targetRef="Gateway_Assess_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assessed" sourceRef="Gateway_Assess_Join" targetRef="Gateway_Approval_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval_Split" targetRef="Task_Procure"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rejected" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval_Split" targetRef="End_Rejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToInstall" sourceRef="Task_Procure" targetRef="Task_Install"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToTest" sourceRef="Task_Install" targetRef="Task_Test"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToRollOut" sourceRef="Task_Test" targetRef="Task_RollOut"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToTrainingSplit" sourceRef="Task_RollOut" targetRef="Gateway_Training_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrainingYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Training_Split" targetRef="Task_Training"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrainingNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Training_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Training_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrainingDone" sourceRef="Task_Training" targetRef="Gateway_Training_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToSupport" sourceRef="Gateway_Training_Join" targetRef="Task_Support"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToEnd" sourceRef="Task_Support" targetRef="End_Supported"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
